headline: Back to profit as portfolio growth offsets a tighter spread
summary_short: AGNC's Q2 2026 diluted EPS was $0.52 (net income $654M), a swing from Q1 2026's diluted loss of $(0.17) per share ($148M net loss), as the $97.2B Agency RMBS portfolio grew from $94.7B even as net interest spread narrowed 6bp to 2.00%.
summary_long: AGNC returned to profitability in Q2 2026: diluted EPS $0.52 and net income $654M, versus a $(0.17) diluted loss ($148M net loss) in Q1. Comprehensive income was $0.52/share and economic return on tangible common equity was 6.7%, versus a 1.6% economic loss in Q1, driven by a $0.20 increase in tangible book value per share plus the $0.36 dividend. Net spread and dollar roll income (non-GAAP) fell to $0.40/share from $0.42 as a 6bp net-interest-spread decline from lower asset yields on portfolio repositioning was partly offset by lower funding costs. The portfolio grew to $97.2B from $94.7B, shifting toward higher-coupon specified pools; at-risk leverage held at 7.4x. No numeric forward guidance was given for revenue, EPS, or dividends.

drivers.explanation: Basic EPS swung to $0.53 from a $(0.17) loss in Q1, tracking net income's rebound; weighted basic shares also rose to 1,157.6M from 1,122.6M on continued common stock issuance, a modest drag on the per-share gain.
Diluted EPS followed the same swing to $654M net income from a $148M Q1 loss, with diluted shares rising to 1,162.0M from 1,122.6M on ongoing common stock issuance.

The swing from a $148M Q1 loss to a $654M Q2 gain reflects portfolio-level mark-to-market gains as Agency RMBS outperformed hedges for a fifth straight quarter amid the period's rate and spread moves, per the MD&A.
Cash fell to $457M from $493M q/q, consistent with continued portfolio growth (about $2.2B of specified pools added) and ongoing dividend/financing outflows disclosed in the cash-flow statement.

Equity rose to $12,543M from $12,181M q/q as $603M of comprehensive income available to common stockholders and $568M of new common stock issuance exceeded $416M of common dividends declared, per the equity roll-forward.
Diluted share count rose to 1,162.0M from 1,122.6M q/q on $568M of new common stock issuance during the quarter, per the equity statement.

AGNC returned to profitability as Agency RMBS outperformed hedges for a fifth consecutive quarter (6.7% economic return on tangible equity vs a 1.6% Q1 loss), even as net interest spread narrowed 6bp on lower asset yields from portfolio repositioning.
